data.narrative:
Rebel Space is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Carrie and Gabriel Hernandez that has raised $2.8M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers spanning Defense & Security—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $2.8M raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $7M. Peer-median analysis examines five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE (Seed, $1.0B), Stark Defence (Series A, $4.0B), Castelion (Series A, $1.0B), Singularity (Series A, $400M), and NODA AI (Series A, $125M). The median valuation across this set is $1.0B, with a range of $125M to $4.0B. The two methods produce sharply divergent results, reflecting the wide variance in early-stage defense-tech valuations.

Triangulating these approaches yields a valuation range of $6M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $504M. The extreme width of this band reflects material uncertainty around Rebel Space's positioning relative to the peer set. Key variables driving final valuation include product maturity relative to comparable firms, defensibility of the technology, and near-term revenue trajectory.
